summary: Ephemeral contractor seat pool + prorated renewal for QuillForge onboarding
description: Issue summary: Request procurement and configuration for a flexible/ephemeral seat pool from vendor QuillForge. We need an initial 40 ephemeral contractor seats (30 US, 10 EU) with ability to burst +10 seats for short trials. The vendor's licensing portal only supports seat-based subscriptions and charges full-month on renewal. We require prorated billing for mid-cycle additions and an invoice tied to cost center ENG-Infra (PO# PF-2026-09).
impact: Engineering contractors on the infra & documentation teams cannot access required tooling for a 2-week pilot starting 2026-03-10. Delays block onboarding of 6 contractors and an internal benchmark run. Finance needs the prorated billing terms clarified before issuing the PO.
requested_seats: 40 ephemeral (30 us-east, 10 eu-west) with +10 burst capacity
seat_type: floating ephem-seat-pool with admin console and SCIM provisioning
investigation_notes:
- Confirmed QuillForge supports SCIM + SAML SSO; SCIM provisioning requires admin token and has an EU data residency flag.
- Security requested SOC2 Type II attestation and data processing addendum; vendor provided redacted AICPA report on 2026-02-25.
- Billing reviewed sample invoice: vendor charges on monthly anniversary and does not pro-rate by default. Procurement asked for written confirmation of prorated credit for mid-month seat additions.
- Legal flagged clause on subprocessing that requires amendment (we need standard Redwood DPA).
- Technical: identity team verified SAML metadata exchange works in staging; will need a separate EU org instance for EU-residency seats unless vendor provides region-scoped tenancy.
- Related Confluence onboarding checklist template copied to /confluence/display/PROC/QuillForge-Onboarding (see related_confluence_pages).

resolution: In progress - awaiting Legal DPA sign-off and vendor confirmation of PO terms. Planned workaround: provision US ephemeral seats for contractors not handling EU-data; pause EU seat allocation until DPA complete.
resolution_notes: If Legal signs DPA and vendor accepts PO with prorated annotation, procurement will issue PO PF-2026-09 and request one-time prorated credit for any seats added before the next monthly anniversary. Identity will set up SCIM + SAML; Security will validate EU tenancy documentation post-signing.
